content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The reliance on conventional payment platforms can cripple your business if those services become inaccessible. COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure sidesteps these issues by providing a fully independent solution where you retain complete control over your digital products and transactions. Unlike platforms that take hefty commissions—like Gumroad's 10% on each sale—NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, which significantly increases your profit margin, allowing you to keep more revenue in your pocket.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before launching your digital store, ensure you have essential tools ready. You will need a domain name to establish your online presence, a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your storefront, and a backend solution such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for handling transactions. Additionally, you will need access to NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing and a storage solution like Supabase or Google Drive for hosting your products. Each of these components is crucial for creating a seamless shopping experience for your customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions and ensure automatic confirmation upon payment. Configure Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage the backend logic required for processing orders. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for hosting your digital products, allowing for instant delivery once a transaction is completed. This setup ensures that customers receive their purchased products immediately, enhancing their shopping experience and minimizing delays.
Stop losing money to platforms that charge high fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Begin by testing your payment process with a small transaction to verify everything works as expected. Monitor the integration between NOWPayments and your backend to confirm that orders are processed correctly. After successful testing, promote your store through social media or other channels. Once your first transaction goes through, you’ll have a clear path to generating revenue and building your brand without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully deploying your store, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to streamline your growth process. Implement marketing strategies to attract more customers, such as offering discounts or bundling products. As your sales increase, consider enhancing your backend capabilities to handle higher transaction volumes and ensure a smooth customer experience. Scaling is about optimizing your infrastructure and marketing to reach a broader audience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by setting up your own store using sovereign infrastructure tools. Use platforms like NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, which allow you to retain more revenue compared to conventional platforms. This approach gives you complete control over your sales process, ensuring you can transact freely and efficiently.
Gain complete control over your digital product sales.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit offers everything you need to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring you can operate independently and profitably.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can establish your own store using sovereign infrastructure, integrating NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. This method eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms while allowing you to retain full revenue.

Utilizing NOWPayments and a custom setup with tools like Google Drive and Cloudflare can help you sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees. This setup ensures your profits remain intact.

Yes, by creating your own online store using sovereign infrastructure, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. This ensures greater control over your sales.
How much can I save by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms?

By using NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction, you can save significantly compared to platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%. For example, on 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921.
What tools do I need to start selling digital products?

You will need a domain, a hosting service, backend logic tools, NOWPayments for payment processing, and a storage solution for your products. Each component is essential for launching your digital store.
